quests.title: Short Delivery, UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The UNSW High Street order has been two cartons light every week since a Tuesday and the invoice says otherwise every time. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $148 owing to UNSW High Street and it is not going to walk in here itself. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: $148, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The UNSW High Street Run
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. I do the UNSW High Street run at the back of seven and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Randwick
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. I have got a whiteboard with last March still on it in the back of the van and the UNSW High Street shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while

quests.title: The Regulars, UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Three of the UNSW High Street regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $57 down on those days. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Do not let them talk you into anything.

quests.title: The Wholesaler, UNSW High Street

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us
